title: AI-assisted preparation prompts
body: Tool-agnostic prompts. AI drafts; a named human reviews facts, sharing, and capability claims before anything is used or sent.

lines.label: Authorized inputs
lines.text: Verified interview notes, current steps and systems; provided timings with evidence labels.

lines.label: Prompt
lines.text: Draft separate current and proposed future timeline tables: step, actor, system, active time, elapsed wait, evidence, handoff, control and exception. Leave unknowns blank/marked unknown. Never invent measured timings or unsupported write actions. Preserve source review, approvals and escalation. List SE/customer validation questions.

lines.label: Required output
lines.text: Two-state maps; assumption log; measurement gaps.

lines.label: Human review
lines.text: SE checks feasibility; workflow owner validates sequence and time basis.
